title: Driveway Gate quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Fabrication and installation of a new custom steel sliding driveway gate for a residential property in St Kilda, Melbourne. Gate dimensions: 4.5 metres wide x 1.8 metres high. Frame from 50x50x2.0mm SHS steel, with vertical infill battens fabricated from 50x10mm flat bar steel, spaced at 20mm gaps. Finish to be Monument colour powder coating. Supply and install two 100x100x3.0mm galvanised steel gate posts, 2.4 metres long each. Supply and install 6 metres of heavy-duty galvanised steel ground track with four heavy-duty steel gate wheels. Supply and install one BFT Deimos Ultra BT A600 sliding gate motor kit, including two remote controls and safety photo-cells. Supply and install one Aiphone JO-1MD video intercom system, including external gate station and internal monitor. Includes demolition and removal of existing old timber gate and posts, concrete footing for track, post installation, and electrical connection for motor and intercom. All necessary wiring and trenching included.
workingDetail: Gate frame and infill (steel or aluminium), Gate posts or tracks, Hinges or sliding wheel kit, Gate motor and automation kit
